note: Wikidata has no hobby categories in the S3 query (instance or subclass of hobby, without sports and art forms), so there is nothing to map from. A domain for a new candidate comes from a person's proposal (data/knowledge/proposals/S3.json) or, for a merge, from the activity it merges into. A source that does have categories (for example a later S2 name list) puts its mapping here: { "<source category>": { "domain": "<domain id>", "sub": "<sub id>" } }.
